issue.title: [flora] Create the approved saguaro pilot mortality textures: dead sprout and charred remains
issue.body:
## Summary

Epic #2526, slice EFM-8. Create the two art-only assets the saguaro pilot
needs to exercise the flora fallback contract (#2530): a dead juvenile and a
generic fire-killed remain. `sprout_charred.png` is deliberately NOT part of
this manifest, so EFM-9 can prove that a fire-killed sprout prefers
phase-appropriate `sprout_dead.png` over the adult-shaped `charred.png`.

This is an art prerequisite. Do not add `textureVariants` to
`data/flora/saguaro.yaml` or change any code here; EFM-9 integrates.

Verified on master `7680c9ef6`: `assets/textures/flora/saguaro/` holds
`sprout.png` (48×48), `matured.png`, `matured_flowering.png`,
`matured_fruiting.png`, and `dead.png` (all 128×128, RGBA) from #1688 /
PR #1725. `tools/texture_subset_audit.py` checks only declared paths, so an
undeclared file under the directory is inert until EFM-9 declares it.

## Required assets

Create under `assets/textures/flora/saguaro/`:

- `sprout_dead.png` — 48×48 RGBA
- `charred.png` — 128×128 RGBA

Filenames follow the contract's convention (phase, then condition/cause
suffix; a generic cause asset carries only the cause), and the YAML
selectors EFM-9 declares are authoritative, not the names.

## Visual requirements

### Shared style

- Match the landed saguaro set: hard pixel edges, compact shading, restrained
  palette, transparent background, no soil, dirt mound, painted shadow, or
  scenery.
- Keep the same ground-contact row and canvas placement as the living asset
  each one replaces, so a state change does not shift the plant.
- The silhouette must remain readable at native scale and must read as the
  same species as `sprout.png` / `matured.png`.

### `sprout_dead.png`

- The `sprout.png` juvenile after death from any cause: a narrow, unbranched
  young saguaro, shrivelled and collapsed inward, desiccated tan-brown to
  grey with ribs showing, no green tissue.
- It must read as a dead juvenile, not as a shrunken copy of the adult
  `dead.png` skeleton and not as a healthy sprout recoloured.
- Preserve `sprout.png`'s footprint and base row; the plant may slump or
  narrow but stays grounded.

### `charred.png`

- The mature saguaro after fire: blackened, charred trunk and arms with
  ember-grey and ash highlights on the rib edges, arm tips possibly broken or
  burnt short, no green tissue, no flames, smoke, or glow.
- Preserve `matured.png`'s trunk, arm count, branching, base row, and canvas
  placement so it is recognisably the same individual burnt, and visibly
  distinct from the weathered tan skeleton in `dead.png`.
- This is the generic cause asset: it represents fire-killed remains of a
  mature plant only. Do not draw a juvenile variant.

## Art workflow

Before generating or drawing anything, stop for the repository owner to
choose one of:

1. Supply the art manually.
2. Generate it through the documented PixelLab workflow
   (`docs/asset_generation.md` §Flora pipeline, including the band-restore
   rule for colour-shifted stages).

Present both textures at native size and enlarged with nearest-neighbour
scaling for explicit owner approval before opening the art PR. The owner
runs `cabal run exe:synarchy -- --preview flora/saguaro` themselves; agents
do not open the preview window. Every texture requires approval, and any
rejected texture is regenerated and re-presented, never landed.

## Acceptance

```bash
python3 - <<'EOF'
from PIL import Image
for name, size in (("sprout_dead.png", (48, 48)), ("charred.png", (128, 128))):
    im = Image.open(f"assets/textures/flora/saguaro/{name}")
    assert im.mode == "RGBA" and im.size == size, (name, im.mode, im.size)
    alpha = im.getchannel("A").getextrema()
    assert alpha[0] == 0 and alpha[1] == 255, (name, alpha)   # real transparency
    print("OK", name, im.size)
EOF
git diff --stat origin/master -- . ':!assets/textures/flora/saguaro'    # empty
python3 tools/texture_subset_audit.py                                    # unchanged, clean
```

Expected: both `OK` lines; the diff outside the saguaro directory is empty;
the audit is unchanged. Plus, recorded in the PR: native and enlarged
previews of both assets, the owner's `--preview flora/saguaro` verdict, and
the owner's explicit approval of each texture before merge.

## Out of scope

- `sprout_charred.png`, drought-, frost-, disease-, or damage-specific
  saguaro art, seasonal dead variants, and a toppled variant.
- Any other texture family (see the design's backfill list).
- YAML integration, resolver, persistence, or engine changes (EFM-9).

## Related

- Epic #2526 (child EFM-8). Phase 4, `independent`; `depends on #2530`
  (filename and selector contract only); `not on the critical path` until
  EFM-9, which is `blocked by` this issue.
- #1688 / PR #1725 (closed) — the base saguaro set this extends.
- #1787 / PR #2136 (closed) — the last approved flora art workflow.
- Design record: `docs/environmental_flora_mortality_design.md` (D-2, D-8,
  D-15 through D-17, D-20); supporting pointer, not required context.
